title: Mexican Rice
description: A little rice side for the Mexican dinner. Choose tomato, or swap it for lime and coriander if that’s what we fancy.
imageAlt: Warm editorial photograph of fluffy tomato rice with separate terracotta-tinted grains and coriander.
imageCaption: Styled cookbook image · Mexican tomato rice
personalNote: When the 12 minutes are up, switch the stove off and leave the lid alone for another 10. Then gently fluff it with a fork. Squishing it around breaks the grains and makes the rice mushy.
equipment: Medium saucepan with a well-fitting lid
advancePrep: Boil the measured water. Wash the rice 3 times and drain it well before adding it to the bubbling pot.
importantNotes: Both versions use 500 ml water, 300 g rice and 1 chicken or beef stock cube for the full batch. Cook covered for 12 minutes on low heat, then rest with the lid closed for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Wash the rice 3 times
steps.description: Wash the rice in cold water 3 times, then drain it well. We can do this while the flavoured stock comes to a boil.

steps.title: Add the rice and cover
steps.description: Once the stock cube has dissolved and the pot is bubbling, add the washed, drained rice. Cover with the lid, turn the heat to low and cook for 12 minutes.

steps.title: Switch off — don’t open the lid yet
steps.description: Turn off the stove and leave the lid closed. Let the rice rest for another 10 minutes.

steps.title: Gently fluff it with a fork
steps.description: Now open the lid and gently fluff the rice with a fork. Don’t squish it around, because that breaks the grains and makes it mushy. Serve with the filling and whichever other sides we’re having.

substitutions.title: Chicken or beef stock
substitutions.text: Use whichever stock cube we have or fancy.

substitutions.title: Not in the mood for tomato rice?
substitutions.text: Pick the lime and coriander tab. For the full batch, replace the tablespoon of tomato paste with the juice of 1 lime and a handful of chopped coriander leaves.

storage: Cool saved rice quickly, refrigerate promptly and use within 24 hours.
reheating: Reheat saved rice once until steaming hot throughout.
servingSuggestion: Two dinner portions, with maybe an extra lunch for you. Serve with the filling, guacamole or beans; choose whichever sides we fancy.
portionNote: The full batch is for 2 portions at one dinner, with maybe an extra lunch for you. Make another batch for the second dinner if needed.
choiceIntro: Pick the flavour for tonight. The rice, water and stock cube stay the same.

recipeOptions.label: Tomato rice
recipeOptions.description: Tomato paste and a stock cube flavour the rice. This is the usual tomato version.

beforeSteps.title: Make the tomato stock
beforeSteps.description: Boil the measured water — 500 ml for the full batch — and pour it into a medium saucepan. Add the tomato paste and the chicken or beef stock cube. Let it boil, stirring until the cube dissolves.

recipeOptions.label: Lime and coriander rice
recipeOptions.description: Skip the tomato paste and use the juice of a lime and a handful of chopped coriander instead.

beforeSteps.title: Make the lime and coriander stock
beforeSteps.description: Boil the measured water — 500 ml for the full batch — and pour it into a medium saucepan. Add the chicken or beef stock cube, the lime juice and the chopped coriander. Let it boil, stirring until the cube dissolves. We’re using the lime and coriander instead of the tomato paste.
